* `edge_curl.T = diag(L_e) C_intᵀ diag(1/A_f)` divides each face contribution by *that face's* own width, whereas the dual-mesh curl is `Me⁻¹ Cᵀ Mf = diag(1/S_e) C_intᵀ diag(l_f)`, which divides by the distance between the two face centres. The two coincide only on a uniform mesh, so on any padded/graded mesh the "primary field" was an O(1)-wrong, **non-convergent** discretization, and `s_m = -iω·Me·b_p` lost the structural property `s_m ∈ range(Cᵀ)`, injecting a resistivity-independent spurious secondary field over the whole domain.
